transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because... I've been having this issue lately. What made me finally decide to make an appointment is that after some really long days on the site—I supervise a construction crew—or sometimes after a neighborhood meeting, I’ll come home and just eat way more than I ever meant to. 

I'll go through leftover takeout, cereal, chips, just whatever’s there in the kitchen. And I don't really stop until I’m uncomfortably full. It's been bothering me, so I figured I should talk to someone about it.
After these episodes of eating, do you do anything to try to make up for the food you ate, like making yourself throw up, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

Yeah, um... I do. Not every time, but maybe a few times a month after those nights, I'll go into the bathroom and make myself throw up. I just start to panic about undoing all the work I’ve put into looking put-together, you know? So... yeah, I have done that.
Could you tell me your current height and weight?
I'm 5'6", and right now I weigh about 135 pounds.
For about how many months has this pattern of overeating and making yourself throw up been going on?
I'd say it's been about... maybe seven months? Yeah, about seven months. It started right around the time I changed how I present myself for this more visible supervisory role at work.
On average, how many times a week do these episodes of overeating happen?

Well, looking back over the last few months... I'd say it averages out to about once a week. It fluctuates a little bit—like, some weeks it might happen twice, and then other weeks it doesn't happen at all. But on average, it's about a weekly thing.
How much does your body shape or weight influence how you feel about yourself as a person?

Honestly, it influences me quite a bit. Since I started wearing more fitted work clothes for this new role, and, you know, being up front at meetings a lot more... I catch myself judging my whole day just by whether my pants feel tight in the morning. Or whether I think people can see my stomach when I'm standing up there. If I feel like I look heavy, it just kind of dictates how I feel about myself and my confidence for the rest of the day.
On average, does making yourself throw up happen at least once a week, or is it less often than that?

It's pretty much tied directly to the overeating I just mentioned. So, looking back over the last few months... the whole pattern of eating like that and then making myself throw up averages out to about once a week. Like I said, um, some weeks it might happen twice, and other weeks not at all. But yeah, on average, it definitely happens at least once a week.
